install: set -euo pipefail; if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1 && { ! command -v bwrap >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; }; then sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq bubblewrap shellcheck; fi; if [ ! -x /usr/local/bin/node ] && [ -x "$(command -v node)" ]; then sudo ln -f "$(command -v node)" /usr/local/bin/node 2>/dev/null || sudo cp -p "$(command -v node)" /usr/local/bin/node; fi; ADLC_VER="$(node -p "require('./package.json').devDependencies['@adlc/cli']")"; if [ "$(adlc --version 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$ADLC_VER" ]; then npm install -g --ignore-scripts "@adlc/cli@${ADLC_VER}"; fi; if ! command -v codegraph >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm install -g @colbymchenry/codegraph; fi; npm ci; if [ -d .codegraph ]; then CODEGRAPH_TELEMETRY=0 codegraph sync; else CODEGRAPH_TELEMETRY=0 codegraph init -y --local-only; fi
